_comment: Retrieval benchmark questions. A chunk answers a question when it contains every `expect` string (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized): the fact plus the labels that make it interpretable, e.g. a table's column header and row name, not just a bare number. Documents live in tests/fixtures/.
